text:
Sara: FYI support case #98765 — customer reports SSO login failing after IdP cert rotation. They see an ACS redirect loop and SAML signature errors.

customer-xhr: Here's the SAML error we get in our SP logs: "Signature verification failed: unsupported algorithm ecdsa-with-SHA256". We rolled cert yesterday (IdP said ECDSA).

Mike: @Sara can you paste the IdP metadata URL + the ACS URL they're using?

Sara: metadata: https://idp.example.com/metadata.xml
ACS used by customer: https://app.customer.com/saml/acs (behind our proxy at acs-proxy.prod.redwood.com)
They also said Host header gets rewritten.

Mike: Two quick possibilities: SP library doesn't support ECDSA signatures, or our proxy rewrites Host/Proto causing signed Recipient mismatch. Can you get the raw SAMLResponse xml (base64) from the customer?

customer-xhr: attaching excerpt:
-----BEGIN SAML-----
...base64...
-----END SAML-----
Decoded snippet shows: <ds:SignedInfo><ds:SignatureMethod Algorithm="http://www.w3.org/2001/04/xmldsig-more#ecdsa-sha256"/></ds:SignedInfo>
Also Recipient="https://app.customer.com/saml/acs" but in request logs our proxy forwards to https://acs-proxy.prod.redwood.com/internal/acs

Anya: :eyes: If the Recipient doesn't match the actual request URL the SP will reject. Also some SPs validate signature algorithm list. We should check: (1) does the SP lib support ECDSA? (2) does our acs-proxy preserve Host/Proto and SAML Recipient/RelayState?

Mike: Repro steps I ran locally:
1) curl -s https://idp.example.com/metadata.xml | xmllint --xpath "//KeyDescriptor/KeyInfo/X509Data/X509Certificate/text()" -
2) echo 'base64string' | base64 --decode > saml.xml; xmllint --noout saml.xml
3) openssl x509 -in cert.pem -text -noout -> shows Public Key Algorithm: id-ecPublicKey
So IdP rotated to ECDSA.

Sara: Customer says they only saw failures after our last deploy of the acs-proxy (deploy-bot: deploy acs-proxy v3.7.1 at 2024-07-22T09:12Z).

deploy-bot: deploy acs-proxy v3.7.1 rolled to prod at 2024-07-22T09:12:13Z — change: normalize host header to proxy hostname for internal routing.

Mike: Aha. That change will cause Recipient mismatch. Short-term mitigation: set proxy to pass original Host header (or set X-Forwarded-Host and update SP to accept forwarded host). Also temp workaround: ask IdP admin to include the proxy hostname as an allowed ACS recipient in signed Assertion (not ideal).

Anya: For ECDSA: we can add fallback to verify with old RSA cert if IdP still publishes previousKeyDescriptor in metadata. Check metadata for multiple KeyDescriptor elements with use="signing".

Sara: Customer provided metadata excerpt: <KeyDescriptor use="signing"><ds:KeyInfo><ds:X509Data><ds:X509Certificate>MIIB...</ds:X509Certificate></ds:X509Data></ds:KeyDescriptor>
No previous RSA cert present.

Mike: Next steps:
- Ask infra to revert host normalization on acs-proxy (ticket #INF-4321)
- Add ECDSA support to SP lib or upgrade (lib-saml v2.3.0+)
- If can't upgrade fast, request IdP to re-add RSA key or sign with RSA-SHA256
I'll open a canary patch to accept forwarded Host header as a test.

Sara: Filing support follow-up: told customer mitigation steps and requested SAMLResponse and metadata. Will ping when INF-4321 has ETA. Thanks @Mike @Anya

customer-xhr: thanks, appreciate help. We're blocked for SSO logins.
